digest: Coverage centred on Ferrari after Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton collided for the second time in three races, with one pundit calling for real consequences and Guenther Steiner expecting the board to react (Motorsport.com), while the BBC questioned whether the partnership is sustainable (BBC Sport). Max Verstappen converted pole into his 75th win, and both Mercedes drivers slipped off the podium late on (Motorsport.com). Isack Hadjar finished 15th after a front wing failure and penalty, while Arvid Lindblad believed a podium was possible before his spin (RaceFans).
